description: This source file defines a static internal class 'RuntimeContext' in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, responsible for managing the grain context within a thread. It provides mechanisms to get, set, and reset the current grain context, using thread-local storage.

classes.name: RuntimeContext
classes.description: Provides thread-local management of the current grain context, including getting, setting, and resetting the context.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Property to retrieve the current grain context.

methods.name: SetExecutionContext
methods.description: Sets the current grain context and outputs the previous context.

methods.name: ResetExecutionContext
methods.description: Resets the grain context to a specified original context.
